section_summary.extract_value: This section investigates social support as a mediator in the relationship between gratitude and loneliness. Regression analysis showed that gratitude significantly predicted loneliness and social support, even after controlling for gender, area of origin, and study major. Social support also significantly predicted loneliness. A Sobel test (z = -6.28, p < .001) confirmed social support's significant mediating role, with 50% of the total effect of gratitude on loneliness being mediated. The text refers to data presented in 'Table 2', but this table was not provided.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details a mediation analysis investigating the role of social support in the relationship between gratitude and loneliness. Regression analyses, presented in Table 2, show that gratitude significantly predicted loneliness and social support, even after controlling for gender, area of origin, and study major. A Sobel test (z = -6.28, p < .001) confirmed that social support significantly mediated the effect, with 50% of the total effect of gratitude on loneliness being mediated by social support, supporting the study's hypotheses.
